# Vendored MinHook

ConsGHost builds against the unmodified MinHook 1.3.4 source in `minhook-1.3.4/`. The adjacent ZIP is the original upstream tag archive. [MinHook source](https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/tree/v1.3.4) · [Original ZIP](https://codeload.github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/zip/refs/tags/v1.3.4)

The ZIP's SHA-256 digest is `172708123daa0c98d20d3a980b16a50be14af243dc95dee6f79c24193ad010e4`.

The [upstream license](minhook-1.3.4/LICENSE.txt) includes the MinHook and Hacker Disassembler Engine notices. Preserve it with source and binary distributions that include MinHook.
